name: InterContinental Presidente Cancun Resort
positioning: Beachfront resort in Cancun's Hotel Zone, surrounded by white sand and Caribbean water, with sea-view suites, a pool steps from the sea and a spa with a signature massage
best_for: Couples wanting a Caribbean beach stay with sea-view balconies and spa time
Families, since children sharing their parents' room stay at no extra charge and there is a kids' club
Golfers, with Cancun Golf Club at Pok ta Pok a short walk away

facts.text: The resort is at Kilometer 7.5 of Boulevard Kukulkan in Cancun's Hotel Zone.
The spa has a jacuzzi, sauna rooms and massage rooms.
Le Cap Beach Club serves Mediterranean cuisine on the beach, next to the adult pool.
The Deck Bar on the beach serves cocktails with sunset views.
Cancun Golf Club at Pok ta Pok is a 12-minute walk away, and Golf Puerto Cancun a 15-minute drive.
The resort is near the Convention Center, Party Center, Puerto Cancun and La Isla shopping centers.
Guests can easily transfer from the resort to Xcaret, Isla Mujeres, Tulum and Chichen Itza.
Children are welcome at no extra charge when sharing their parents' room.
The resort has a kids' club.
The hotel holds EarthCheck third-party sustainability certification.
The hotel is close to Cancun nightlife.

highlights.text: The outdoor pool has five jacuzzis and sits just steps from the Caribbean Sea, next to the Deck Bar.
Suites have private balconies with views of the Caribbean Sea.
The resort is surrounded by white sand and the clear waters of the Caribbean.
The special 80-minute IKAL massage combines four massage techniques from around the globe.
El Caribeño, under a large palm-thatched roof, overlooks the beach.

considerations.text: Classic Rooms may have lagoon views.
The resort is 25 minutes from Cancun International Airport.
WhataHotel notes the resort is in the busy Hotel Zone area.
